---
title: "Figures from knitr"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      # the figures stay files beside the deck unless embed-resources is set
      postRenderCleanup: ['${input_stem}.commonmark_x_files']
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['figure img[alt="A scatter plot."]', 'figure figcaption']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        - selectors: ['figure figcaption']
          matches: ['Figure.1: Three points\.']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        - ['!\[A scatter plot\.\]\(.*fig-pts-1\.png\)\n\nFigure.1: Three points\. \{\.caption\}', 'See Figure.1']
        - ['fig-alt', 'quarto-xref', 'cell-code']
---

```{r}
#| label: fig-pts
#| fig-cap: "Three points."
#| fig-alt: "A scatter plot."
plot(1:3)
```

See @fig-pts.
